findings.failure_path: MR creation/update now routes only to pre-merge-landing-checks.md. The relocated branch exceptions explicitly require checking remove-source-branch during MR creation, but the table places those protections under post-integration cleanup. A release or dev→main MR can be created with automatic source deletion enabled and merged by another actor before the creating agent reads the teardown reference.
findings.smallest_fix: Route MR creation/update and configuration of remove-source-branch to the canonical permanent/integration and release-branch exceptions.

findings.failure_path: The table requires “并带 head SHA 守卫”, while the relocated canonical protocol says the guard is recommended. This converts advice into a mandatory merge condition, contradicting the unchanged-policy acceptance and potentially blocking an otherwise permitted merge.
findings.smallest_fix: Preserve the canonical qualification: “建议带 head SHA 守卫”.

findings.failure_path: The assertion named “ignored-artifact scan before removal” checks only substring presence. Moving the scan below git worktree remove leaves every new text assertion green, despite violating the safety-critical ordering requirement.
findings.smallest_fix: Assert that the scan and its exit-zero requirement precede removal, and verify that an isolated reorder mutation fails that assertion.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the placement heading and pin-search paragraph change, but the packet omits existing ledger anchors targeting this file. The ledger tail and claimed resolution count cannot establish that every previously anchored phrase survives; an unresolved anchor can stop the full validator before its combined verdict.
findings.smallest_fix: Include the existing locators targeting both edited paragraphs and their candidate resolution evidence in the review packet.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the added rows contain precise statistics and research conclusions, but only citations and assertions that sources were read are supplied. The bounded packet cannot verify the required claim-to-primary-source agreement.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply the relevant primary-source excerpts or table cells, with version and section identifiers, for each added row; narrow unsupported conclusions.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the profile places make -k test before the final fix and records only focused reruns afterward. It supplies no regression-heavy outcome. The attached root contract requires full validation plus the heavy lane for shared-text changes, so release readiness on this candidate is not established.
findings.smallest_fix: Record full-lane evidence on the final candidate or prove tree identity with the tested candidate, and provide the required heavy-lane result.

The reminder adds cleanup safeguards without new shell interpolation. Protected remote branches remain exposed when auto-deletion is configured during MR creation.
Displayed executable control flow is unchanged. An MR merged by another actor can bypass the creating agent's later merge/teardown read.
The new assertions inspect emitted text but do not enforce scan-before-removal ordering. Complete current-candidate regression evidence is missing.
No command-tree or output-schema change is shown. Requiring a SHA guard introduces a restriction beyond the canonical recommendation.
The files and registry changes can be reverted together without data migration, but release validation is not established for the final candidate.
Registered diagnostic names remain intact. Preservation of all existing ledger locators cannot be verified from the supplied ledger tail.
The research rows state evidence limitations, but their numerical and source-derived claims lack primary-source excerpts in the bounded packet.
Branch-preservation checks must fire before configuring automatic source deletion; routing them to post-integration cleanup is too late.
No contract is loosened. The root contract's current-candidate validation requirement remains unsupported: the full run predates a fix and no heavy-lane result is supplied.
